g.text: Authentication | Login, delegation and refresh reuse
Reset failures; INSERT refresh hash + family
[Bad password for an active, unlocked account]
Forward login status, body and issued cookie
Render authenticated screen or login error
audience / expiry; set tenant DB context
Domain response or service authorization error
401; do not dispatch to domain API
Refresh after a resource response is 401
single in-flight promise per JS runtime
Revoke active rows in family; COMMIT
Forward refresh status, body and cookie headers
Bars show execution/waiting scopes; dashed arrows return to the caller.
The gateway relays responses; backend APIs do not bypass it.
Principal lookup is routed to Identity, not to a domain service.
A missing refresh cookie is rejected before the token lookup.
Logout revokes the presented refresh row, not every issued access JWT.
Multi-tab refresh coordination is not provided by the single-runtime promise.
Secure-cookie production configuration remains a release gate.
